note: Two-column chapter-opening page. body_text_size_px=20.5 measured as the cap-to-baseline height of 'A' in 'Amines constitute...' (y777-797px) and 'L' in 'Like ammonia...' (y1633-1653px) in the right column. Chapter palette sampled from flat interiors: lavender chapter banner #d0afd3, darker lavender divider strip below it #bc9dca (role rule_bar), pale-yellow display panel behind the numeral 9 #ffeda9, salmon #f48480 for the marginal rules and the vertical bar beside the Objectives box, bright brick red #e11a22 for the 'Objectives' script heading, grey #6d6e71 for 'Unit' and for the numbered section heading '9.1 Structure of Amines'. THREE JUDGEMENT CALLS. (1) Block n=3 'Unit 9' is one block whose two parts print at very different sizes: the word 'Unit' is 57px tall (2.8x body) and the display numeral '9' is 196px tall (about 9.6x body). A single honest ratio for the numeral is outside the checker's 0.4-4.0 ratio window, so size_rel is reported at the 4.0 ceiling for the combined lockup; the true measured values are 2.8 and 9.6. (2) Block n=2's text begins with the word 'Objectives', but that word is set in red script well above the list and above the salmon rule, so it is reported as a separate section_heading element with n:null and n=2 is carried by the box holding the objectives list itself. (3) The QR code is A2's block n=1, but qr_code is a furniture role that must take n:null, so block 1 is deliberately unmatched. This page prints no page_header_band and no footer_rule; the only band-like elements are the lavender divider under the banner and the two salmon marginal rules, all reported as rule_bar. The Objectives box sits on bare paper (no fill) - its colour is the salmon bar at its left edge and the salmon rule above it, which are separate elements. Page foot carries only the 'Reprint 2026-27' line (running_header); no folio number is printed on the opening page.
